Hi David,

Thanks for writing in, and sorry for the trouble.

Before anything else, here is where your order stands. Shop···· is paid and nothing has shipped. It is a pre-order for the Magic Miner 40T, which means a unit is being manufactured and built for you, and what you paid has already gone into that build. The ship date on your order is October 31, 2026, so it is very close now. You can follow that batch on its way to our warehouse here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

I have put a hold on the order so nothing leaves the warehouse while we settle this with you.

If you would rather not wait for the 40T, there are two things I can do for you right away. I can put the full amount you paid on your HeliumDeploy account as store credit, which applies at checkout on anything in the store. Just reply with which of those suits you, or tell me what made you want to cancel, and I will work from there.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
